name: Helpful Neighbor
description: Fill a boat crate, truck order, or townie request for 3 different Neighbors (any neighborhood).

name: Derby Req
description: Complete your Neighborhood's derby requirement (Carnival/Resort: submit an activity screenshot to your NH chat).

name: Pet Pics
description: Submit a pet picture (could be your pet, someone else's pet, or a wild animal you wish were your pet!).

name: Historian
description: Visit a local library, museum, monument, or other public place of archival or historical significance. Submit a picture and tell us about the visit.

name: Culture
description: Tell us about the music you're listening to lately or a show/movie you've seen recently. Also rate it and include a link or picture.

name: Copy Cats
description: Group up with two other players (team of 3) and each of you complete 4 identical derby tasks with matching point values in the same order during the same derby.

name: Farm Design!
description: Submit a farm design to the August 'Fair' themed FF decoration competition. No specific decorations are required—put some thought into how to make creative use of the theme.

name: Carrots to Carrots
description: Write a funny Hay Day-related caption for your family mascot reaction image, then react to at least one other caption from a fellow family member.

name: Fair Vendor
description: Collect at least 10 of every unlocked item in a Fair-related production machine of your choosing (Pie, Candy, Ice Cream, Deep Fryer, Waffle Maker, Popcorn, Hot Dog, Fudge, or another approved machine).

name: Farm & Chat
description: Attend any Council Member-hosted Farm & Chat session.

name: Moody
description: Share your current mood or what's going on in exactly 3 emojis, then guess someone else's.

name: Pride Annex!
description: Spot a rainbow or something rainbow-colored in real life and share it.

name: Meet The Neighbors
description: DM someone in the community you've never talked with much. Find something outside of Hay Day that you have in common, then share it while respecting their privacy.

name: Nurture
description: Achieve 500 points in the Weekly tab of the Neighborhood Nurture event.
